The *Saraṇaduka, Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 24.22) is a canonical treatise situated within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final book of the Theravāda *Abhidhamma Piṭaka* [SuttaCentral]. Like other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it applies the system of conditional relations (*paccaya*) to specific paired dyadic categories of phenomena (*duka*), here analyzing the dyad of *Saraṇa* (states accompanied by mental defilements or conflict) combined with the *Piṭṭhiduka* ("end dyads" or supplementary pairs) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
